lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. A distinct vertical grouping of four large, high-luminance spots is visible immediately following the fifth branchial slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance values that intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern posterior to the gill region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges along the mid-to-upper flank, characterized by a sharp tonal transition with high pixel intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and significant shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated dark silhouettes (commensal Echeneidae) attached to and swimming directly beneath the ventral surface of the right pectoral fin.
